source.title: National Central University female dormitory14 official entrance photograph

direct_observations: Pale gray cyan tiled surrounding frames and dark narrow horizontal openings below the coarse screen blocks.
Low canopy is green translucent panels with a distinct red frame; therefore its full side/underside is not a single established green finish.
Stone entrance piers, brick low narrow adjacent piers and bluegray arch are visibly distinct material families already represented by original colors.
same_component_inference: 464 originally neutral solid-wall reveal faces of58 narrow slots take original pale gray cyan material1. The hidden reveal finish is inferred from the visible host and repeated opening family, not separately observed.
not_used_to_infer_rear: The original2008 Commons opposite-side photo was not downloaded or used for new color mapping because it is unregistered to this partial study. No new actual rear evidence is claimed.
study_scope: Artificial rear and outer-side cuts, coarse upper blanks and depth assumptions are retained. This is not a complete dormitory model or2026-condition survey.
